# llms.txt for kirbychanmarkham.com

> Kirby Chan & Co. Real Estate Team (eXp Realty Brokerage) helps people buy and sell homes in Markham, Ontario. Kirby Chan is a Broker. Office: 8763 Bayview Ave #127, Richmond Hill, ON L4B 3V1. Phone: 416-305-8008.

Every figure on this site is dated and cites its source. Market prices come from Toronto Regional Real Estate Board reports for the period stated and are not an appraisal.

## Main pages

- [Markham downsizing guide](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/downsizing-markham/): costs, timing, where downsizers move in Markham, tax and seniors programmes
- [Free home valuation](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/home-valuation/): request a valuation based on recent comparable sales
- [Markham neighbourhoods](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/neighbourhoods/): twelve neighbourhood guides with prices by property type
- [Services](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/services/): buying, selling, luxury, relocation, upsizing, first-time buyers, new construction, investors, estate sales, separation and divorce
- [Blog](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/blog/): sourced guides on land transfer tax, closing costs, property tax, the FHSA, condo status certificates and the GO train commute
- [Meet Kirby Chan](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://kirbychanmarkham.com/contact/)
